selection_rule.rule: per holdout origin, stable-descending sort by G1_graph predicted probability; take the first k rows with label==0, k=max(30, ceil(0.01*n))
selection_rule.tie_handling: stable sort; no exact ties observed in the stored probabilities
selection_rule.b2_comparison_rule: the identical top-k label==0 rule is applied to B2_frozen_spec16; a G1-selected case is 'shared_with_b2' iff it is also in that B2 set, 'graph_specific' otherwise

classification_rules.LABEL_FAILURE: in-window raw filing of the same (company_key, track_id) that is not a qualifying event: Special/Abbreviated/Direct/Dual/Post-NSE 510(k) or a PMA supplement
classification_rules.DATA_FAILURE: entity swap (same applicant_raw under another company_key in the window), track-mapping conflict (code maps to the predicted track but the event is filed under another track), a material pair filing hidden by the estimated +14-day knowledge clock just before the origin, lane-unobservable pair premise, or DB coverage that cannot see the 36-month dormancy window or the label window
classification_rules.RELATIONAL_CONSTRUCT_FAILURE: no label/data artifact, row is graph_specific and the graph increment is positive (delta_logit>0): the relational features are the cause of the false positive
classification_rules.MODEL_FAILURE: false positive already present in the non-graph baseline, explained by company/track activity counts, with no label/data/relational artifact
classification_rules.UNVERIFIABLE: no post-cutoff record and no frozen source to establish what happened
classification_rules.graph_driver_type: count_restatement if the largest graph contribution is a feature with max|r|>=0.7 against some B3 history feature, else relational_analogy
